svg.title: Agentic 路由策略 / 完整任务生命周期
svg.desc: 源码可追溯的 LLaMAR agentic 编排图。MissionGraph 是逻辑 DAG 权威；PhysicalDispatch 与 MissionRuntime 是物理状态权威；Team ACK 只在满足参与者数量与 delivery adapter 门控时进入；逻辑终态经 Router/LLM 选择 ready 节点，再由 send_message(activate_plan_node) 进入 activation gate；MissionRuntime.abort 只从独立的 mission-level finalizer gate 进入。
svg.metadata: Source-grounded artifact for LLaMAR agentic orchestration. Implementation anchors: src/a2a/coordinator/mission_runtime.py:37-105,451-532,538-599,603-732,813-860 src/a2a/coordinator/mission_graph.py:322-453,476-590,621-665 src/a2a/coordinator/task_store.py:339-473 src/a2a/coordinator/agent_executor.py:440-450,472-486,885-901,975-1012 src/a2a/builtin_tools/send_message.py:393-472 Physical terminal matrix (source: mission_runtime.py:65-105): PREPARED -> FAILED; DISPATCHING -> FAILED; ACCEPTED/RUNNING/INPUT_REQUIRED -> COMPLETED|FAILED|CANCELED; CANCEL_PENDING -> CANCELED|FAILED. Important gates: Team ACK entry = len(participants) > 1 && TeamPartitionService.has_delivery_adapter. MissionGraph._recompute_frontier() produces ready/blocked; it does not activate a node. Router/LLM chooses a ready logical_id; send_message(activate_plan_node) calls runtime.activate_plan_node(). MissionGraph.mark_dispatch_terminal() updates logical state/frontier only; MissionRuntime.abort() has a separate finalizer owner.

g.text: Agentic 路由策略 / 完整任务生命周期
Source-grounded · one context-scoped Mission · logical DAG, physical dispatch, Team ACK, and independent finalization
A · 逻辑计划层 + 激活入口
MissionGraph = logical DAG authority · logical_id only
ACTIVATION SPINE · DAG gate → atomic claim → gated Team ACK → awaited fan-out

rect.title: Team ACK entry gate and saga

g.text: true: Team ACK saga PREPARING → INSTALLED

path.data-source: Team ACK entry gate else: single participant OR no Team adapter

g.text: else / no Team ACK → awaited fan-out
PhysicalDispatch / MissionRuntime = canonical physical lifecycle authority
NON-TERMINAL SPINE · one canonical state per physical dispatch
RUNNING ⇄ INPUT_REQUIRED · only apply_physical_status() changes canonical state
TERMINAL SOURCES · explicit source matrix; no terminal state is inferred from a shared gray bus

rect.title: Terminal-source matrix for all allowed nonterminal to terminal transitions
Any non-terminal state may enter the cancellation fence

g.text: C · 状态回流、逻辑聚合、frontier feedback 与独立终止
logical terminal → recompute frontier → mediated activation; abort has a separate owner
LOCAL FRONTIER FEEDBACK · terminal → frontier → Router/LLM → activate_plan_node → activation gate
same DAG gate as section A
